packMeta.name: People Hub (SoftN + Forms)
packMeta.description: Turnkey HR & people operations desk with actionable approvals inbox, recruitment pipeline & interview scorecards, interactive onboarding checklists, leave, performance reviews, expenses, training, and exit interviews. Includes the full-stack SoftN application plus 8 schema-matched FormLogic forms & management charts sharing the same live SQLite database.
